newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola ends sharply as crusher, commission buy.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola ends sharply as crusher, commission buy.

text.p: WCE canola futures ended sharply higher as crushers and commission houses bought.

"Crushers bought August, September and November and commission houses were good buyers, Cargill bought 25 January late," a canola trader said. November WCE canola crush profit margins fell to -3.70 Monday from +1.10 Friday. RBC-DS bought 500 July-Nov at $40 from UGG, Sep-Nov spread at $1. Volume was 5,880 lots, or 117,600 tonnes.
July canola rose $10 to $383, August was up $10 to $363.90 and November ended up $7.80 at $346.30. September and November flax rose $8 to $288 and $286 as crusher and exporter buying.
October western barley rose $3.90 to $126 as LFG covered shorts and commercials sold scale up. December closed up $3.50 at $127.10. Volume was 1,225 lots.
October feed wheat rose $3.50 to $150.90 and December was up $3.80 at $151.80 as LFG bought, traders said. Oct-Dec spread from $0.30 to $0.80 and July-Oct at $3.60. Volume was 1,381 lots.
UGG bought 25 December oats up the US$5 limit at US$112.50, floor sources said.
(All values in Canadian dollars per tonne except oats, feed peas).
